_about: Public-domain Gustave Xavier de Ravignan (1795-1858, Jesuit preacher of Notre-Dame) in English for the Word Hoard: On the Life and Institute of the Jesuits, tr. Charles Seager (Philadelphia, 1845), Conferences on the Spiritual Life, tr. Mrs. Abel Ram (London, 1873), and Ravignan's Last Retreat, tr. F. M'Donogh Mahony (no year on the title page), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
